name: Exec Cluster E02: Signal Persistence (Pulse vs Zone)
description: Tests: hold_until for pulse-to-zone conversion, pulse AND filter pattern, persistent comparison signals without hold_until, hold_long bar-count hold.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E02: Signal Persistence
# Tests: hold_until, pulse AND filter, persistent signals, hold_long
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === INDICATORS ===
fast_sma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)

# === PATTERN 1: Pulse + filter requires hold_until ===
# crossover is pulse (1 bar). ANDing with filter drops it.
# CORRECT: persist with hold_until first, then filter
golden = crossover(fast_sma, slow_sma)
death = crossunder(fast_sma, slow_sma)
held_long = hold_until(golden, death)
held_short = hold_until(death, golden)

# Filter: only trade when RSI confirms
long_entry = held_long and (rsi_val > 50)
short_entry = held_short and (rsi_val < 50)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=5)
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=15)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Signal Persistence: SMA + RSI Filter',
    category='Signals',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fast SMA', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Slow SMA', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RSI', color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(fast_sma, slow_sma, rsi_val))
